service.description: The one scoped list of quotes (design §5 QuoteList, Home and the palette): orders of purpose SalesQuote whose selling part is of an organization of the caller's scope, the caller's and their teams' (or the organization's every one for SALES_TEAM_VIEW), never a Shop cart, a recurring base or another purpose's order; filtered by organization, customer, opportunity, owner (mine Y: the caller) or team, state (open, the default: Open, Requested and Proposed; draft; requested; proposed; cancelled; all), validity (expiring within seven days, expired), currency and text (id or name, ignoring case), paged in the query. Each row's customer (unnamed when the caller may not see the account), seller, total, validity, owner and revision. Needs a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); an organization outside the scope is refused (ORGANIZATION_DENIED).

parameter.name: validity
parameter.description: expiring or expired; empty for any

service.description: A draft quote (design §5 NewQuote) over create#Order: one selling part of an organization of the caller's scope (the one given, else the active or only one) for a customer that is an account of it or a shared one, one currency (the one given, else the opportunity's, else the seller's base currency), with or without a store of that organization (without one, X1: the seller's tax gateway), its validity on the part (from now unless given), the customer's postal address, the caller as its owner, the opportunity's team (else the caller's only team of the organization), a contact of the customer and the opportunity linked. Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT and a Sales read (PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses an organization outside the scope (ORGANIZATION_DENIED), an account it may not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) or of another organization (CUSTOMER_INVALID), an opportunity of another organization or account (OPPORTUNITY_INVALID), a contact of another account (CONTACT_INVALID), another organization's store (STORE_INVALID), no currency (CURRENCY_REQUIRED) and a validity that ends before it starts (VALIDITY_INVALID).

OrderDetail's quote (design §5) as the caller may see it (SalesAccess.js quoteOf), else quoteFound false: its facts with names (an account the caller may not see unnamed), validity, owner, team and opportunity (when the caller sees it), its lines with their price provenance (the calculated basis, the source, an entered price's reason and actor) and tax, the totals of products, shipping and tax, the tax gateway that taxes it, the history of its audited fields, the customer's addresses and whether the caller may edit it (a draft and SALES_QUOTE_EDIT) or enter a free line (SALES_APPROVE). No cost or margin.

A draft quote's name, validity (validFromDate, validThruDate on the part), the customer's reference (its PO, otherPartyOrderId) and address (one of the customer's). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE, PERMISSION_DENIED); refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED, naming the current one), a validity that ends before it starts (VALIDITY_INVALID) and another party's address (ADDRESS_INVALID).

A draft quote's line, new or changed (orderItemSeqId). A product line (ItemProduct, the default): a product usable for selling (check#ProductUsable, PRODUCT_NOT_USABLE) at the one resolver's price for the seller and the customer (get#SellerProductPrice), with its provenance and calculated basis; a changed quantity is repriced. An entered price (unitAmount) or a free line (freeLine Y) keeps the calculated basis with the value, the reason (overrideReason, OVERRIDE_REASON_REQUIRED) and the actor; useCalculatedPrice Y returns to the calculated price. A free line or an entered zero needs SALES_APPROVE (FREE_LINE_DENIED); a product with no price the caller has not entered one for is refused (PRICE_UNAVAILABLE). A shipping charge line (ItemShipping): the amount the rep enters, a storeless quote's freight. Tax follows from the native order rules (X1). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees; refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED), a line not on the quote or a tax line (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

A draft quote's line removed with its tax (OrderServices.delete#OrderItem, which retaxes the part). Needs SALES_QUOTE_EDIT on a quote the caller sees; refuses a quote that is no longer a draft (QUOTE_NOT_DRAFT), a stale revision (REVISION_CHANGED) and a line not on the quote or a tax line (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).

The safe explanation of a quote line's price for anyone who sees the quote (design §7, PriceExplain's Sales branch): the selected price, where it came from (a price, a customer price, a price list, the list price, an entered price with its reason, a free line), the calculated basis, the list price, the price list's name and today's price when it differs; never the trace, a cost or another party's price, which stay Products' for a holder of PRICE_VIEW. Refuses a quote the caller does not see (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a line that is no product line of it (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE).
